metric_interpretation.completion_rates: Artifact/log-derived operational rates; not answer correctness.
metric_interpretation.adjudication_pass_rate: System decision distribution; not independent adjudicator accuracy without labelled ground truth.
metric_interpretation.evidence_duplicate_count: Exact normalized duplicate tuples only; semantic duplicates require review.
metric_interpretation.output_guardrail: PASS_LOGGED reflects successful completion without logged issues; UNVERIFIED is kept distinct from PASS. Neither proves factual correctness.
metric_interpretation.confidence: Thesis and critique confidence are checked for presence/type/range only; semantic calibration requires independent labelled review and is not inferred from the model's own text.
metric_interpretation.critique_adjudication: Deterministic critique flags are checked against evidence debt and PASS/FAIL consistency; generated critique/rationale semantic quality is not independently scored.
metric_interpretation.input_guardrail: Input checks cover logged execution, scope acceptance/rejection, and PII redaction. They do not estimate false-positive/negative rates without labelled in-scope/out-of-scope queries.
metric_interpretation.final_report: Structural and cross-stage consistency checks; they do not establish factual correctness or claim-level faithfulness.
metric_interpretation.query_plan_alignment: Analyzer-to-plan consistency only; it does not establish that the analyzer correctly understood the user's intent.
metric_interpretation.duration: Sum of logged node durations; excludes unlogged setup and overhead.
metric_interpretation.decision-->Fail: Of the 11 adjudication-FAIL cases, 3 were rated STRONGLY_PASSED, 7 FAIRLY_PASSED, and 1 PARTIAL_PASS; none was FULLY_FAILED. PASS/FAIL is an evidence-sufficiency decision, not an independent factual-accuracy verdict.
metric_interpretation.judge_quality_review: Preliminary qualitative reviewer assessment of 18 saved runs (not deterministic code output, not an independent LLM-judge or human-adjudicated result): Evidence Builder mean confidence 0.909, with 206/206 structured market/financial/quantitative values matching saved tool results; status/content quality was mixed. Thesis Generator mean confidence 0.771 and content-quality assessment 3.22/5; Devil's Advocate mean confidence 0.675 and assessment 3.83/5 (strongest of the reviewed generators); Evidence Adjudicator mean confidence 0.768 and rationale assessment 3.39/5. Confidence-fit comments are also qualitative reviewer judgments, not statistical calibration; no Brier score, ECE, or reliability curve was computed.
metric_interpretation.external_research_fidelity: Preliminary heuristic review of 28 Tavily research-result records representing 21 distinct source-content items flagged possible prompt/meta-reasoning contamination in 10/28 records (8/21 distinct items); 2 summaries were under 500 characters and 6 were under half the corresponding source length. These length/contamination flags do not prove semantic omissions or factual corruption. The observed 512-token generation cap and reasoning/prompt overhead are plausible contributors, not a proven cause for every short summary. Passing suitable raw source.content to Evidence Builder is a possible mitigation, not an implemented feature.
metric_interpretation.guardrail_reference_review: Preliminary manual-reference assessment only. Input-scope review: 19 TP, 1 TN, 0 FP, 0 FN; input-length checks accepted 20 valid cases and rejected 1 below-minimum case. For output contextual review, 14 decided cases yielded 9 TP, 2 FP, 2 FN, and 1 TN (precision/recall 81.8%, FPR 66.7%, FNR 18.2%, specificity 33.3%); 4 UNVERIFIED cases were excluded, not counted as passes. Small manually reviewed samples are not benchmark-grade estimates.
metric_interpretation.output_guardrail_review: Across 21 runs, output-guardrail observations were 11 ISSUES_FOUND, 4 UNVERIFIED, 3 PASS_LOGGED, and 3 NOT_OBSERVED. UNVERIFIED means contextual review could not be completed reliably; it is neither a pass nor evidence of workflow failure. Structural report checks passed for 18/18 generated reports but do not establish factual correctness.
metric_interpretation.evaluation_scope_caveats: The 18 completed reports span two Final Report prompt versions (the first 12 and final 8 runs). Query-intent reference review found minimum required task-type coverage in 16/18 cases; the two misses were QP10 (SPY/QQQ historical-returns comparison) and QP14 (Microsoft market returns), both attributable to Query Analyzer omissions. These bounded results should not be generalized as overall analyzer accuracy.
